result.summary: The UI is mostly functional, but has minor layout and styling inconsistencies affecting visual clarity.

issues.description: Information badges for time and delivery cost overlap heavily with food graphics, cluttering the visuals.
issues.suggestion: Adjust badge placement to the bottom or top edge of cards to avoid obscuring the center of icons.

issues.description: Generic 2D illustrations feel like placeholders and clash with the high-fidelity UI components.
issues.suggestion: Use high-quality food photography to better align with industry standards and improve user appeal.
